files.scripts/rename_captions.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s dotglob
dir=$1
for file in "$dir"/*.TXT; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  mv -- "$file" "${file%.TXT}.txt"
done
